purpose: Show which supplier/network created the campaign source.
validation: Must be one of approved supplier enums.
tech: Keep visible for admin only; client must not see supplier source.

validation: Not empty. Trim and de-duplicate spaces.
tech: If canonical merchant exists, display canonical name; keep raw merchant in detail.

purpose: Link to merchant/brand website or campaign landing page.
validation: Valid URL or blank with NEEDS_REVIEW flag.
tech: Do not use tracking URL here; this is website/landing link.
May differ from Brand Name; do not merge blindly.

purpose: Main business category used for filters.
validation: Must map to approved category or NEEDS_REVIEW.
tech: Do not store offer text or country here.

validation: Nullable; if present must be approved subcategory.

tech: If global, store is_global=true and countries=[] or GLOBAL consistently.

validation: Valid ISO4217 or blank with NEEDS_REVIEW.
tech: Currency may differ from client payout currency later.
Do not use category for CPS; CPS belongs here or commission_type.

purpose: General campaign details for admin review.
validation: Nullable, but flag if all description fields are blank.
tech: Long text should open in detail drawer, not crowd table.

purpose: Campaign rules/terms for admin and compliance.
validation: Nullable; if present must be sanitized.

purpose: Summary commission displayed at campaign level.
validation: Must not be used alone for final client payout if value is Up to/Multiple.

purpose: Supplier tracking or generated campaign tracking URL for admin.
validation: Valid URL; hide from client-facing catalog unless wrapped by MBO link.
tech: Client should get MBO tracking URL, not raw supplier URL.
Do not confuse synced date with campaign start date.
Expired should drive campaign_status if supplier confirms.

purpose: Campaign operational state, not join/application state.
validation: ACTIVE, PAUSED, EXPIRED, SUSPENDED, DELETED, NEEDS_REVIEW.
tech: Do not put notapplied here. notapplied belongs to Relationship Status.

purpose: Short offer/promotion text shown to admin.
Percent discount shown for coupon/offer campaigns where available.
validation: Nullable decimal; keep Discount Display for non-percent offers.
